target_customer: B2B SaaS companies that need flexible pricing, packaging and billing, including usage and per seat hybrids
problem: SaaS teams struggle to change pricing and packaging because billing systems are rigid and engineering heavy.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for a pricing plan editor, billing portal and APIs
product_category: SaaS pricing, packaging and billing infrastructure

founders.name: Torben Friehe
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as a former founder.

founders.name: Yann Leretaille
founders.background_notes: YC page names only Yann; Employbl lists Yann Leretaille as a founder.

exit.reason: YC lists the company as Inactive, but wingback.com was live and no shutdown or acquisition was found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Billing, entitlements and a plan editor with integrations to CRM and accounting need careful engineering around money, but use standard components.

defensibility.rationale: Billing integrations create switching costs, but Stripe and incumbent billing vendors could add hybrid pricing features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Current comparison pages put Chargebee, Orb, Metronome and Stigg in the same space; those pages are dated 2026, so they are not used as competitors at founding.

market_need_then: Business Insider covered Wingback's pitch deck in November 2021, and the company raised $1.9M within months, which shows investor interest; no customer spend data is sourced.

branding.domain_note: Uses wingback.com, an exact .com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Product copy about shipping any combination of priced features

rebrands.to: Wingback Pricing (listing name on a directory)

brand_strength.rationale: Press mentions from TechCrunch, Forbes and Fortune are claimed on the site, but brand searches return mostly furniture results for the word wingback.

outcome_analysis: Wingback joined YC Winter 2022 after raising a $1.9M pre-seed in late 2021 and later added a seed entry in April 2022. YC marks it Inactive, but its site and listings show a live billing product, so the status looks stale or the company continued quietly. No shutdown or acquisition news was found, so no cause of failure is public.
notes: Round figures: Signalbase and Extruct say $1.9M pre-seed, VCBacked says $2.3M total with pre-seed in November 2021, CB Insights says $2.27M total with a Seed VC II on 2022-04-01 (amount not stated), Startupintros says $2M seed on 2021-11-01, and Best Pitch Deck says $19M, probably an error. Investor names are not sourced. The Business Insider article is listed on the YC page but was not found in search. Competitor pages found were dated 2026, so the list is empty.
